description: Three-phase step sequencer: nine knobs arranged in a ring, read by three playheads that start a third of the way apart

params.text: Sets one of the nine voltages in the ring, and marks the step output A's eight-step window begins on
Sets one of the nine voltages in the ring that the three outputs read
Steps through All, Phase and Step, which set how much of the pattern a pulse at Rnd trig re-draws; on All the pattern runs sixteen steps instead of eight
Sets one of the nine voltages in the ring, and marks the step output B's eight-step window begins on
Sets the span of the three CV outputs: 0 to 8V on Uni, and -8V to +8V on Bi
Sets one of the nine voltages in the ring, and marks the step output C's eight-step window begins on

inputs.text: A rising edge above 1V advances all three playheads by one step, and a lamp flashes
A rising edge above 1V returns the three playheads to the start of their patterns
A rising edge above 1V re-draws the pattern, by one step, by one playhead or in full, according to the mode switch

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of the step playhead A has reached, an eight-step window of the ring beginning at Start A
Carries the voltage of the step playhead B has reached, an eight-step window of the ring beginning at Start B
A 5V pulse when a playhead returns to the beginning of its pattern
Carries the voltage of the step playhead C has reached, an eight-step window of the ring beginning at Start C

notes: every knob comes up at its lowest position, so all three CV outputs read 0V until the knobs are moved
the lamp beside each CV output glows green for a positive voltage and red for a negative one

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
